Name: FS Seasonal Mermaid Pendant Accessory
Author: Thimblewitch
Description:
[size=3]This is for those of you who are not the fondest of the vanilla style mermaid pendants, have a mod that changes the look of your mermaid pendants in game or maybe you just like pretty colours? Regardless of your reason enjoy!

This pack adds 4 different seasonal versions of a wearable mermaid pendant for your farmer to wear after marriage.

[/size][list]
[*][size=3]Version 1 is a plain and simple seasonal version of the mermaid pendant, each season has a different cord colour and a different shell colour depending on the season.[/size]
[*][size=3]Version 2 has the seasonal shells of version one but the cord is coloured a dark green to resemble kelp or seaweed and it also more closely resembles the vanilla pendant cord.[/size]
[*][size=3]Version 3 has the same seasonal shells as the other pendants but the cord is instead a gold one for those that liked my first pack's gold cord but wanted the pretty seasonal shells.[/size]
[*][size=3]Version 4 has the same seasonal shells other pendants but the cord is instead a silver one for those that liked my first pack's silver cord but wanted the pretty seasonal shells.[/size]
[/list][size=3]
[/size][list]
[size=3]I might be a bit slow going forward with uploading as I am now working on a larger fashion sense pack inspired by one of my latest hyper fixations.

[/size][/list][size=3][u]INSTALLATION[/u]
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿.[/size]
[*][size=3]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense[/url]﻿.[/size]
[*][size=3]Download this mod.[/size]
[*][size=3]Unzip the file and place it in your Mods folder.[/size]
[*][size=3]In game, the pendants will be found in the Accessories section of the Fashion Sense Hand Mirror[/size]
[/list][size=3]

[u]ACKNOWLEDGEMENTS[/u]
[list]
[*][size=3]PeacefulEnd, the creator of Fashion Sense because without their mod this pack would not have been made possible.[/size]
[/list][/size]
